summary: Tiedemann worked with Albany Mayor John Miki in 2024 to create the city's Gaza ceasefire resolution, an action his campaign highlights on its Positions page. CAIR-SFBA's tracker, dated 2024-03-25, records him as supporting the resolution, noting the entry is not a verified roll-call transcript. The campaign frames the resolution as ensuring the difficult issue was discussed without name-calling or attacks.
